entities.name: Count Johann Nepomuk Wilczek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann Nepomuk Wilczek, known to friends as "Hans Wilczek", was an Austrian arctic explorer and patron of the arts. He was the main sponsor of the Austro-Hungarian North Pole Expedition in 1872–74.
